name: Pieter Jansen
bio:
Pieter Jansen's motorsport journey began amidst the roar of engines at Kyalami, where he spent his youth mesmerized by Formula One. His analytical mind and deep understanding of vehicle dynamics led him to pursue a career in race engineering, initially working with local touring car teams before making the leap to Europe. He quickly established himself as a meticulous and insightful engineer, known for his ability to optimize performance under pressure.

As Sporting Director, Pieter brings a data-driven approach to race strategy and team management. He is unflinching in his pursuit of excellence, setting high standards for both himself and his team. His demanding nature is tempered by a deep loyalty to his colleagues and a commitment to fostering a culture of continuous improvement. He stands out for his ability to remain calm and decisive even in the most chaotic race situations, a quality that has earned him the respect of drivers and engineers alike.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed salt-and-pepper hair, receding hairline
physical.description: A stocky man with a serious demeanor, Pieter always looks like he is deep in thought.

quirks: Always carries a well-worn copy of 'The Art of War'.
Insists on a specific blend of rooibos tea before every race.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when concentrating.
